text:
```yaml
name: E2E Windows

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  e2e-windows:
    name: E2E Windows (Non-Interactive)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache: true

      - name: Install mise
        uses: jdx/mise-action@v2

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: mise install

      - name: Build CLI
        run: mise run build

      - name: Run E2E Tests (Non-Interactive)
        run: mise run test:e2e
        env:
          # Ensure tests know they are on Windows to skip interactive sessions
          OS: windows
          # Disable interactive prompts for CI
          CI: "true"

      - name: Notify Slack on Failure
        if: failure()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1.26.0
        with:
          payload: |
            {
              "text": "Windows E2E Tests Failed",
              "blocks": [
                {
                  "type": "header",
                  "text": {
                    "type": "plain_text",
                    "text": "🚨 Windows E2E Tests Failed"
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "section",
                  "fields": [
                    {
                      "type": "mrkdwn",
                      "text": "*Commit:*\n${{ github.sha }}"
                    },
                    {
                      "type": "mrkdwn",
                      "text": "*Branch:*\n${{ github.ref_name }}"
                    }
                  ]
                },
                {
                  "type": "section",
                  "text": {
                    "type": "mrkdwn",
                    "text": "View logs: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
```
